hud.overwhelmed.hint: Park it. Swap or rest — both are valid.
overwhelm.title: Parked. That’s allowed.
overwhelm.body: Swap to something lighter, or rest. Nothing to catch up.
unstick.deeper.look: Look at the thing — don’t touch yet
unstick.deeper.touch: Touch it once, then rest your hands
hyperfocus.chip: You’ve been in this stretch for a while. Pause, water, or keep going — all fine.
routing.hint.onset: Onset often suits low or medium load. A hint — ignore anytime.
routing.hint.peak: Peak can hold medium or high load if you want it. A hint — ignore anytime.
routing.hint.comedown: Comedown tends to suit low load. A hint — ignore anytime.
routing.hint.unknown: Zone unknown until a dose is logged. Pick anything.
buffer.label: Time buffer
hyperfocus.setting.hint: After this many continuous minutes. Dismissible. Never cuts focus.
hotkeys.title: Keyboard
hotkeys.body: c or / capture · Space start/pause · d done · u Un-Stick · h Too Hard · o Overwhelmed · s Swap · r Rest
aiBrainDump.label: AI brain-dump
aiBrainDump.hint: Off by default. Local stub only — no API. Review before saving. Offline parks the raw dump. Voice is later.
